thread:
jess: Heads up — post-deploy we're seeing a small but consistent invoice delta for some EU tenants (~0.4-0.8% tokens) in hourly previews. Looks tied to ingest epoch flips around service restarts.

omar: Yikes. Any specific evidence pointing to the epoch sync rather than routing/fanout?

jess: I pulled a couple sample sessions. Pattern: events land with ingest_epoch X for a few minutes, then next batch has epoch X-1 for the same session id range. Tally joins by (tenant, ingest_epoch) so some tokens are grouped into the old epoch and excluded from the new window.

jess: Example log snippet:```
2024-04-01T03:12:09Z ingest[pid=67] INFO epoch=204 auth=tenant:acme session=abc123 event_id=...
2024-04-01T03:12:15Z ingest[pid=82] INFO epoch=203 auth=tenant:acme session=abc123 event_id=...
```

kai: That can happen when the epoch coordinator leader restarts and another node hasn't fully reconciled. We recently changed the lease TTL in the last deploy, right?

jess: yep — TTL reduced from 15s to 5s to speed failover. That probably made transient flips more common under GC pressure.

ingest-bot: deploy #ingest v2.14 rolled at 2024-04-01T02:58Z (canary->prod) :rocket: (no immediate errors flagged)

lina: Short term: can we add a ledger-side grace when aggregating across epochs? e.g. treat epoch drift <= 2 as same-group for invoice preview. That should reduce undercount while we fix coordinator.

mike: We could also emit a metric to the dashboard: `metering_events_total` by `ingest_epoch` and `epoch_delta` per-session. Quick prometheus query: ```sum by (ingest_epoch) (increase(metering_events_total[5m]))``` then a side query for sessions with multiple ingest_epoch values.

omar: I like the dashboard idea first — visibility -> product won't freak out. Jess, can you attach an example query and heatmap card?

jess: I'll add a temporary card to the billing preview dashboard showing counts by ingest_epoch and a sparklines panel for per-tenant drift. Linking query and sample logs in the card.

kai: For the medium-term fix: bump the coordinator lease TTL back to 15s, add a quick handshake on leader-change so in-flight workers hold a short quiesce window before flipping epoch. That should stop flips under normal GC. Also add an idempotent write path so events are reconciled if they land in the wrong epoch.

lina: +1 to idempotency — avoids backfills later. But that's a bit more work. What's the rollback risk if we change TTL?

mike: TTL -> 15s increases failover time but 15s is acceptable for our SLOs. We need a canary in region EU-west with synthetic load to measure failover latency.

jess: Proposed action items: 1) add dashboard card (me, 1hr). 2) hotfix: treat epoch_delta <=2 as same-group in preview(tentative, ops toggle) (kai + jess, today). 3) revert TTL to 15s and add leader-change quiesce + idempotent writes (infra + ingest team, next sprint). 4) backfill tool to reassign mis-attributed events if needed (mike, optional).

omar: can we also surface an alert when a tenant has >0.1% of sessions spanning multiple epochs in a 1h window? that would be a good early warning.

jess: agree — I'll add the alert as a low-severity early-warning (pager off) and a slack webhook to #billing-ops.

ingest-bot: automation run scheduled: billing-preview-card-deploy by jess at 2024-04-01T04:05Z

lina: sounds good. timeline?

jess: dashboard card up in ~45m, hotfix PR in review now (link: https://github.com/redwood/infer/pull/4221). Ill post canary results here.

mike: if hotfix looks ok, we should coordinate with finance for tomorrow morning invoice preview run so they can validate.

omar: solid plan. Thanks for the fast triage. :eyes:

kai: one more note — let's add txn-level `ingest_epoch` to the invoice preview sampling logs for 48h so we can audit the reconciliation if finance flags anomalies.

jess: done — enabling `epoch` field in preview sampling for 48h. I'll update the runbook.

lina: :thumbsup:

jess: will follow up with canary numbers in ~1h.
